why: An added role grants lasting permissions. The person or test-world authority may apply it; a secretary may on words bound to the exact sorted card, and with no words the door asks the person's grant, which the card asks the person about first. A change to a card's words still needs the person's words and the owner's decision whatever the list answers (card-words.ts), so the grant alone carries only a change that leaves the words as they are.
